title: Prompt-only RSI loop, first valid run
notes: First run with harness-side scoring on hidden labels (after four aborted runs, see Findings from earlier runs in the top-level README). gen0 = Tumble's original prompt; each child rewrites the research and meta prompts from its parent's run evidence.
